catalysts.headline: Deutsche Bank initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $1,200 price target on Lumentum's III-V laser/AI-optics franchise, coinciding with product showcases at the European Conference on Optical Communications (ECOC)

Q4 & full fiscal year 2026 results: Q4 net revenue $1.01B (+109.3% YoY, +24.5% sequentially); GAAP net loss of $7.2B (-$84.65/diluted share) almost entirely from a one-time, non-cash $7.8B debt-extinguishment loss on convertible-note conversion; non-GAAP diluted EPS $3.23 (beat $2.97 consensus); FY2026 net revenue $3,014.0M vs FY2025's $1,645.0M; non-GAAP FY2026 diluted EPS $8.67; total cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of $2.7B (+$1.9B YoY); CEO guided Q1 FY2027 revenue midpoint to $1.25B on AI demand

notes: Theme 'AI Semiconductors' is kept — Lumentum makes optical/photonic components (lasers, transceivers, co-packaged-optics parts) rather than semiconductors in the strict sense, but it is tightly integrated into the same AI-datacenter-interconnect supply chain this theme is used for elsewhere in the system (e.g. TER, MRVL), so it is treated as a reasonable fit rather than a mismatch. themeLabel 'hot sector' reflects management's own characterization of optoelectronics demand as sold out through roughly 2029, a reported multi-hundred-million-dollar co-packaged-optics order deliverable in H1 2027, and a joint PCIe-over-optics demo with Astera Labs and Corning said to be planned for the 2026 OCP Global Summit (exact date not confirmed this session, so left out of the dated catalysts list per the 'every catalyst needs a date' rule).
